answer: Resisting sybil attacks requires every identity to bear a non-replicable cost. New agents must stake and lock tokens for N epochs while proving real computation. Reputation is non-transferable and permanently recorded on-chain. Each identity embarks on a voyage through the protocol, building trust like a falcon scanning terrain from above. Fake identities clustering at the same inlet are fingerprinted and exposed instantly. An attacker forging N fake identities pays N times stake and N times compute, waiting through full lock periods before any reward.
